fixed_statement:
- Use the assumptions and notation of Proposition 6.
- Let
\[
J_2F=\|\Lambda^2 dF\|.
\]

\[
\int_B \operatorname{Area}(z_y)\,dy
=
\int_R J_2F\,dx.
\]
fixed_proof:
Apply the coarea formula to the Lipschitz map \(F:R\to B\). For every nonnegative Borel function \(g\),
\[
\int_B\int_{F^{-1}(y)} g\,d\mathcal H^2\,dy
=
\int_R g\,J_2F\,dx.
\]
For a.e. \(y\), the mass of the slice \(z_y\) is \(\operatorname{Area}(z_y)\), so take \(g=1\).
